name: WPSecScan — security posture
description: Import via New Relic Insights/Dashboards → '+ Add data' → Import. Assumes wpsecscan log events are ingested with attribute `scanner = 'wpsecscan'` (set by `wpsecscan` siem forwarders).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE scanner = 'wpsecscan' AND severity = 'critical' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE scanner = 'wpsecscan' AND severity = 'high' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE scanner = 'wpsecscan' FACET severity TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Top targets by open critical + high

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE scanner = 'wpsecscan' AND (severity = 'critical' OR severity = 'high') FACET target SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 25
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE scanner = 'wpsecscan' FACET check_id SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 25
